notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
description:
Give Red Hulk and Screaming Nemesis indestructible using Heroic Intervention.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
